limitations.statement: R2C reuses R2B held-out data after R2B results were already observed; it is an exploratory method-sensitivity study, not an independent confirmation of any selected calibration method.
limitations.train_refit_failure_policy: Any refit the reused solver cannot certify is recorded per measurement/replicate with its exact error; the affected configuration's train-refit block is marked 'failed' with NO interval computed over the surviving replicates (PART 36 fail-closed).
